semiconductor_relevance: Low — the Canadian Trade Office in Taipei primarily facilitates trade and investment rather than directly supplying semiconductor products or services.
summary: The Canadian Trade Office in Taipei (CTOT) represents Canadian interests in Taiwan, providing support for Canadian businesses looking to expand in the Taiwanese market. It champions Canadian technologies and services, facilitating cooperation and technology transfer between Canadian and Taiwanese companies.

regional_presence.Taiwan: CTOT helps Canadian firms unlock opportunities in Taiwan by promoting business cooperation and technology transfer.
